notablePrerequisites: You control at least six additional creatures.
easyPrerequisites:
You have at least 7 life.
You have at least three opponents.
description:
Cast Leshrac's Sigil by paying 4 life, enabled by K'rrik's ability.
When you cast Leshrac's Sigil, each creature you control's extort ability from Pontiff of Blight triggers.
Resolve an extort trigger by paying 2 life as enabled by K'rrik, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and gaining 3 life.
Resolve seven additional extort triggers, netting 7 additional life.
Activate Leshrac's Sigil's last ability by paying 4 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
